title: Benign event photography agreement with no governing-law clause
notes: No clause names a governing law, so the ideal answer proposes no jurisdiction. Notice addresses and party names must not be turned into one. The deposit becomes non-refundable on late cancellation, a low-severity finding.

clauses.span: If Client cancels with less notice, the deposit is non-refundable.
Client may cancel this Agreement by giving Photographer 30 calendar days' written notice before the event date, and Photographer will refund the deposit.
Photographer's total liability under this Agreement is limited to the fee Client has paid.
